name: io.github.tellagen/mcp-server
description: Tellagen MCP server — investigate incidents with AI agents, post structured findings, and build incident timelines.

environmentVariables.description: Tellagen API key (starts with tllg_). Generate one in Settings > API Keys.
environmentVariables.name: TELLAGEN_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: MCP host identity used to scope local source observations. Supported values: codex or claude. Defaults to codex.
environmentVariables.name: TELLAGEN_MCP_CLIENT

environmentVariables.description: Optional opaque local profile identifier used to scope diagnostic observations across MCP client profiles.
environmentVariables.name: TELLAGEN_MCP_PROFILE_ID
